1 million = 1,000,000

1 billion = 1,000 (plus six zeros)

1 million = 1 (plus six zeros)

38 billion = 38,000,000,000 = 38,000 (plus six zeros)

325 million = 325,000,000 = 325 (plus six zeros)

38,000 / 325 = 116

$116,000,000
